name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page

name: timer_start
description: Start tracking time on a project. Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

arguments.name: task
arguments.desc: What you are working on right now

arguments.name: rate
arguments.desc: Hourly rate for this timer only; defaults to the project rate

name: timer_stop
description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

arguments.name: note
arguments.desc: Optional note stored with the entry

name: timer_status
description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total so far.

name: entry_add
description: Log time you already worked. Give start plus either end or minutes.

arguments.name: billable
arguments.desc: Default true; set false for non-billable work

arguments.name: rate
arguments.desc: Hourly rate override for this entry

name: entry_list
description: List logged time entries as a compact table. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

name: entry_delete
description: Delete one time entry by id.

name: entry_edit
description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

arguments.name: minutes
arguments.desc: New duration in minutes, keeps start

arguments.name: rate
arguments.desc: Hourly rate override for this entry

name: project_set_rate
description: Set the hourly rate used to turn tracked hours into money for a project.

name: report
description: Total tracked hours and money for a period, grouped by project, day, task or tag. Free tier covers the last 7 days.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: ISO date/time start of the period

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: ISO date/time end of the period

arguments.name: group_by
arguments.desc: project | day | task | tag (tag is Pro)

name: export_csv
description: Write time entries to a CSV file you can hand to a bookkeeper or import into a spreadsheet. Free tier exports the last 7 days.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Target file path; defaults to a file in the local data directory

name: invoice_summary
description: Turn tracked time into invoice line items for one project: hours, rate, amount per task, plus the total.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: ISO date/time start of the billing period

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: ISO date/time end of the billing period
